summary.name: HighReach
summary.one_liner: HighReach is an AI creator studio that generates videos, images, avatars, and audio using a range of third-party AI models in one place.
use_cases: Create short videos for reels, ads, or stories
Turn a still image into a video clip
Make voiceovers, music, and sound effects
Explore campaign-style art direction from prompts
summary.what_it_does: HighReach lets users generate and edit images, create videos from text prompts or still images, and produce voiceovers, music, and sound effects in a single studio. The page lists access to several third-party models, including Kling, Veo, Seedance, Nano Banana, and GPT Image, plus newer entries such as Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3 Max, FLUX 3, and Kling 3.0. Users pick a canvas (video, image, or audio), write a prompt or start from an example, then refine variations and download results. Image editing and image-to-video tools accept user-uploaded images, with reference support and upload limits depending on the chosen tool and model. Generation consumes credits, and the cost varies by model and output settings, shown in the studio before generating.
notable: Access to multiple leading AI video, image, and audio models in one studio
Prompt-based workflow with starter prompts and inspiration examples
Image-to-video and image editing from user-uploaded images
Credit-based generation with cost shown before running
caveats: Generation uses credits; cost depends on model and output settings
Reference support and upload limits vary by tool and model
Pricing tiers are not detailed on the page
